decisions.reason: The cobot loading system builds directly on the firm's machining and automation know-how and its in-house development, so it can readily read early market feedback and refine the product, which fits its strategy of smarter automation.

The dual-table loading system extends the established machine offer with closely related knowledge, has low assimilation risk, and supports customers' productivity, so dropping it within a year is unlikely.

The dispensing machine is further from the core, but the firm presents it as a flagship and it won a Red Dot award. Its in-house R&D and its experience with precision motion, controls and software give enough related knowledge to assimilate learning, so management keeps investing rather than withdrawing after one year.
